best_parts: node wx_case + fade1..fade4: faded worked example (Case B 'the skin step is yours this time') builds the method before the learner runs it alone
node fade1_t12: 'You were sure... sign-for-syndrome habit' sure_note paired with a 'Show me why' reveal
node wx_case skip choice 'I know T and N, skip the walk-through' gives a real fast lane that still meets O5 and O6 on fade1 and fade2
flaws: node wx_case: tells the T and N steps before any probe, against the blueprint's 'why-probe before the fork' and ask-before-tell (R1)
node fade2: stem 'In current AJCC staging, ipsilateral supraclavicular node involvement is classed as?' is the trap-map probe verbatim, so it is a drill of the item rather than a new form (R6)
node fade3: '38-year-old, 1.5 cm invasive ductal carcinoma on core biopsy, node-negative, no symptoms' replays the S3 staging vignette almost word for word; penalised for replay of S1-S3 (R6)
node fade1_t4a: option 'T4a' is labelled partial with no trap tag, but its feedback describes the TR13 tethering error; the trap map and the distractor label disagree (R2)
node fade1_t12, fade2_t2, fade3_t5 and others open feedback with 'Not right.' every time, flat in voice (R8)

best_parts: node t_pair: two-woman contrast of peau d'orange with and without the inflammatory picture; the wrong options are the sign-only model (TR12) and the matching-signs model, each refuted with a sure_note
node t_n: same-side versus opposite-side supraclavicular node; 'Patient X / Patient Y' tests the TR2 model on the exact feature that separates N3c from M1, with an honest partial ('Neither')
node t_vig: three distinct errors on one fixity vignette (T4a by fixity, T3 by size, T2 correct), so the answer diagnoses which rule the learner applies
flaws: node t_pair: options 'Woman A' and 'Both' both carry TR12 in one probe, so the wrong answers are two versions of one model and separate less than they could (R2, R9)
node t_pair and t_img: the two-woman skin contrast and the 38-year-old 1.5 cm patient echo the S3 skin and staging vignettes; replayed concept, not a new stem (R6)
no fast lane or skip anywhere in the segment; every learner takes all five probes, so there is no expertise reversal (R5)
node t_prog: a single explain node repeats bone and nodal status without a probe, a small telling step before the segment ends (R1)

best_parts: node r1: opens with a probe on the T category, not a lesson; the learner commits before any explanation
node r2: 'Satellite skin nodules over the breast' as a partial option that tempts and is refuted by the skin-versus-chest-wall rule (K65 versus K64)
node r4: 'Start serum CA 15-3 as a staging test' as a partial that names a real tumour-marker error (K58) rather than a filler
flaws: node r3: stem 'Ipsilateral nodes lie above the collarbone and nothing else is distant' gives away the M0 and nodal answer, so the M1 trap is weakened by the stem (R2, R4)
node r4: '38-year-old, 1.5 cm core-proven invasive ductal carcinoma, clinically node-negative, no symptoms' replays the S3 staging probe almost verbatim (R6)
node r1: stem and options replay the trap-map TR12 probe 'a 3 cm tumour with peau d'orange, no redness or warmth' and the S2 skin mechanism, not a new form (R6)
no fast lane, no skip, no second explanation beyond hints and retries; a confident learner is walked through the same five probes (R5)
feedback opens 'Not right.' in every wrong branch, so voice is flat (R8)

merge_ideas: b's two-woman paired contrast as the opening probe, with a's wx_case skip lane (learner who answers r1-style T4d correctly jumps the faded case) and a's 'Show me why' reveal nodes on each trap
b's t_n same-side versus opposite-side node contrast with c's r3 wording restored to a bare 'Which category?' stem (no giveaway) so the M1 trap is not pre-answered
a's faded-example skip lane placed in front of b's five contrast probes; a's sure_note on the fixity probe with b's three-error fixity vignette
replay_note: Penalised for replay of S1-S3 stems: a fade2 (trap-map verbatim) and fade3 (S3 staging vignette); c r1 (trap-map TR12 stem) and r4 (S3 staging vignette); b t_pair (S3 skin concept, new stem) and t_img (S3 patient, new contrast). Variant b replays least.
